chunks: Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah narrated to me, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the menstruating woman becomes pure before al-ʿaṣr, she prays al-ẓuhr and al-ʿaṣr. But if she becomes pure at the end of the time of al-ʿaṣr, she prays al-ʿaṣr.

key_terms.الْعَصْرِ: the afternoon prayer and its prescribed time
key_terms.طَهُرَتِ: became ritually pure after menstruation ended

ai.seo_question: What prayers must a woman perform if her menstruation ends before or near the end of al-ʿaṣr time?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the salat obligations of a woman when her menstruation ends during the daytime prayer period. It distinguishes between becoming pure before al-ʿaṣr, which requires both al-ẓuhr and al-ʿaṣr, and becoming pure at the end of al-ʿaṣr time, which requires only al-ʿaṣr.
